sources.summary: Develop through MVP in Execute mode; routine in-scope decisions do not require repeated approval.
Credentials-dependent connections may be mocked now; retain real adapters and defer live tests until credentials are provided.
Implement phase by phase, batch meaningful commits, and squash merge each phase PR.

decisions.choice: Configurable DeepSeek model ID; no guessed 4.1 alias. AI_MODE=mock is explicit. Live configuration failure never silently falls back.
Explore remains usable without LLM; manual create-task form uses the same server proposal/approval boundary.
Drizzle/PostgreSQL with credential-free local PGlite persistence; DATABASE_URL selects an external PostgreSQL adapter. Serverless requires an external database.

P0-R01-C02.description: Active instructions reflect explicit MVP authorization while retaining limits on secrets, paid provisioning, deployment and destructive actions.

P0-R01-C04.description: A separate bootstrap process reads durable scope/state and identifies pending checks and current authorization without conversation context; distinguish this simulation from a real new-agent handoff.

P2-R01-C01.reason: Live DeepSeek credentials not supplied; user explicitly authorized mock-first work.

P2-R01-C02.reason: Requires real model behavior, not replaceable by fixture success.

P4-R02-C01.reason: Real-model end-to-end validation awaits credentials; mock end-to-end has a separate check.

P4-R02-C02.reason: Live model paraphrase/variation behavior awaits credentials; deterministic variation is tested separately.

evidence_policy.live-model-run: deferred under SRC-020, never satisfied by mock evidence
evidence_policy.other_kinds: remain required where applicable; exact evidence and limitations must be recorded

checks.description: Mock mode is visibly labelled and executes real read tools over persistent seeded records.
The mock focus -> investigation -> proposed task -> approval -> persisted task flow works; repeat approval is safe.
Live adapter exists, missing configuration fails explicitly, and setup documents exact credential-dependent tests still outstanding.
